27class PublicationThrottle {
28public:
30 using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
31
34 static constexpr Clock::duration DefaultInterval = std::chrono::seconds(5);
35
38 explicit PublicationThrottle(Clock::duration interval = DefaultInterval)
39 : publishInterval(interval) {}
40
50 [[nodiscard]] bool claim(Clock::time_point now = Clock::now()) {
51 if (lastClaimed.has_value() && now - *lastClaimed < publishInterval) {
52 return false;
53 }
54 lastClaimed = now;
55 return true;
56 }
57
60 [[nodiscard]] Clock::duration getInterval() const noexcept {
61 return publishInterval;
62 }
63
64private:
65 Clock::duration publishInterval;
66 std::optional<Clock::time_point> lastClaimed;
67};
